intent: New logo exploration followed by a standalone mark refinement
prompts:
Use case: logo-brand.
Create an exceptionally well-designed original logo identity presentation for Roster, a developer infrastructure product. Roster is a local MCP tool router: an AI agent may have hundreds of capabilities; Roster drafts a small starting five for the task, routes the selected call, and learns from outcomes on the user's machine. Brand qualities: precise, capable, fast, calm, independent, approachable.

Design ONE strong new symbol and consistently use that exact same symbol throughout this presentation. The idea is a compact, confident geometric capital R made from five coordinated solid components with carefully balanced negative space: a selected route through an organized set. The R should be recognizable immediately yet have a distinctive ownable silhouette. A broad vertical foundation, a generous open upper counter, and a decisive forward diagonal leg. Rounded outer corners and crisp purposeful cuts; substantial consistent visual weight. The five components fit into one coherent monogram with clean uniform separation, never a scattering of dots. Make the geometry feel inevitable, beautifully proportioned, and legible at favicon size. Subtle routing meaning, not a literal network diagram. Give the image model's strongest typographic/logo design judgment room to resolve the exact construction.

Visual medium: immaculate flat vector-style brand design with extremely crisp edges. Primary mark in solid cobalt #4963DF. Dark navy #151B29, pearl #F7F8FC, pale cool blue #DFE7FB. The core mark must also work in a single solid color. No metallic effects, bevels, shadows on the logo, outlines, gradients inside the mark, sparkles, circuit-board decoration, generic AI star, mascot, shield, sports-ball imagery, arrows added around the logo, or imitation of any existing technology company logo.

Presentation: polished wide landscape design board, approximately 3:2, premium editorial spacing. Mostly pearl background. Main upper 60 percent: a large cobalt symbol beside an optically kerned title-case wordmark reading exactly "Roster", dark navy, in a substantial clean geometric grotesk similar in spirit to Space Grotesk/Manrope; its capital R should harmonize with the symbol. Generous negative space and clear hierarchy, no sales paragraphs.
Lower portion: a carefully aligned application row showing the SAME exact geometry in three meaningful contexts: a compact pearl website navigation header with the Roster lockup; a navy launch-video end card with the mark and "Roster" in pearl and small text exactly "Your local MCP tool router."; and a small cobalt app icon with the mark reversed in pearl. The video mockup should feel like a clean frame from a fast software launch film. Thin cool-gray dividers, no decorative 3D mockup objects, no browser chrome, no watermarks, no extra invented slogans or business claims. A restrained tiny label "ROSTER / IDENTITY EXPLORATION 01" may appear in the top left. Make this feel like a thoughtful world-class designer presenting ONE refined identity, with perfect consistency of the logo across its applications.

Use case: precise-object-edit / logo-brand.
Input image is a reference for the new Roster symbol. Extract and precisely redraw ONLY the five-piece capital R symbol visible in the lower-right app icon of the reference, with the same five-component construction, silhouette and proportions. This output is the standalone master logo, not a presentation board.

A square 2048x2048 image with a genuinely transparent alpha background. The single R symbol centered and occupying approximately 78 percent of the square, with equal optical margins. No wordmark, no text, no app-icon container, no border, no background color, no checkerboard painted into the image.

Render the R as an impeccably crisp flat vector-style mark in ONE completely uniform solid cobalt color #4963DF, 100 percent opaque except edge antialiasing. Remove absolutely all glow, blur, texture, gradients, shadows, bevels, lighting, photography and atmospheric effects. The five solid components are: tall upper-left stem, short lower-left stem, upper-right rounded bowl segment, middle-right curved bowl segment, lower-right outgoing diagonal leg. Keep five pieces only, consistent intentional gaps, graceful rounded corners and sharp controlled joins. Keep the generous clear separations so the R works at 24px. Optical balance, confident broad geometry, clean high-resolution edges. Preserve the chosen logo's identity, just deliver the refined clean standalone asset on alpha.
note: The generated PNGs are archived unchanged. They are exploration references. The reusable logo is the separately constructed five-piece SVG, with outlined typography and native vector-to-PNG exports.
